newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING--Positron Fiber Systems Corp.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING--Positron Fiber Systems Corp.

text.p: Positron Fiber Systems Corp filed Monday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering for an estimated $40 million in common shares.
The offering will be made through Robertson, Stephens & Co, the Montreal, Quebec-based company said.
Net proceeds will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, including potential acquisitions.
Positron has applied to trade on Nasdaq under the stock symbol "PFSCF".
Positron Fiber Systems Corp designs, develops, markets and supports advanced broadband access network systems for local telecommunications carriers.
